lenses.name: Whole picture
lenses.blurb: What is shown and how it looks, with the arrangement at full weight and the palette at half.

lenses.name: Picture only
lenses.blurb: What is shown and how it is painted, as one learned block. Carries period.

lenses.name: Form
lenses.blurb: Arrangement and palette with the picture block off. Crosses subject and period.

lenses.name: Composition
lenses.blurb: Where light, colour and edges sit on the surface. Nothing else.

lenses.name: Colour
lenses.blurb: Palette alone. About two thirds of each list depends on the photograph, so treat it as a suggestion.

note: Neighbour lists and map positions are precomputed; filters hide entries and never change distances.
